transcript.en_text: Raising the age of retirement is an unacceptable erosion of the American dream.
transcript.zh_text: 提高退休年龄是对美国梦的不可接受的侵蚀。

transcript.en_text: If the Republicans fail to pass a reasonable omnibus package by demanding entitlement reform, they will force the federal government into a spending freeze.
transcript.zh_text: 如果共和党未能通过要求福利改革的合理综合方案，他们将迫使联邦政府冻结支出。

transcript.en_text: The frostbite will be on their hands, not ours.
transcript.zh_text: 冻伤将出现在他们的手上，而不是我们的手上。

transcript.en_text: Do you think that's a bit much? The frostbite bit?
transcript.zh_text: 你觉得这有点多了吗？冻伤了一点？

transcript.en_text: It's the State of the Union. We want to appeal to fly-over states.
transcript.zh_text: 这是国情咨文。我们希望吸引飞越州。

transcript.en_text: - They'll like that line. - I want something more forceful.
transcript.zh_text: - 他们会喜欢那句话。- 我想要更有力的东西。

transcript.en_text: - "Blood on their hands"? - No.
transcript.zh_text: - “他们手上有血”？- 不。

transcript.en_text: - "Throw us back into the ice age." - Oh, I like that, Christina.
transcript.zh_text: - “把我们扔回冰河时代。”- 哦，我喜欢这样，克里斯蒂娜。

transcript.en_text: Let's try that. Linda. Christina, you come up here too.
transcript.zh_text: 让我们试试吧。琳达。克里斯蒂娜，你也来这里。

transcript.en_text: There are two types of vice presidents: doormats and matadors.
transcript.zh_text: 副总统有两种类型：受气垫和斗牛士。

transcript.en_text: Which do you think I intend to be?
transcript.zh_text: 你认为我想成为哪一个？

transcript.en_text: Raymond.
transcript.zh_text: 雷蒙德.

transcript.en_text: He's hung up on the domestic agenda. Not a single word about China.
transcript.zh_text: 他一直专注于国内议程。只字不提中国。

transcript.en_text: His instincts are right. If the government shuts down one day after the speech, not a single word in the speech matters. We have to address the freeze now.
transcript.zh_text: 他的直觉是对的。如果演讲一天后政府关门，演讲中的任何一个字都不重要。我们现在必须解决冻结问题。

transcript.en_text: - China comes later. - Both parties have been wrangling over entitlements for months. What makes you think a miracle's gonna happen in the next three days?
transcript.zh_text: - 中国来得晚一些。- 双方就权利问题争论了几个月。是什么让你认为奇迹会在接下来的三天内发生？

transcript.en_text: We give the Republicans exactly what they want.
transcript.zh_text: 我们给了共和党人他们想要的东西。

transcript.en_text: - Retirement age? - Yes.
transcript.zh_text: - 退休年龄？- 是的。

transcript.en_text: That's a line in the sand we cannot cross.
transcript.zh_text: 这是我们无法跨越的沙线。

transcript.en_text: We will cross it, eventually. So why keep fighting it?
transcript.zh_text: 我们最终会跨越它。那么为什么还要继续抗争呢？

transcript.en_text: I can push this through the Senate, and once I do, the president will announce a major bipartisan agreement in the State of the Union.
transcript.zh_text: 我可以在参议院推动此事，一旦我这样做，总统将在国情咨文中宣布一项重要的两党协议。

transcript.en_text: We avoid a government shutdown and the White House gets credit.
transcript.zh_text: 我们避免了政府关门，白宫也得到了信任。

transcript.en_text: It's a huge risk, and if it fails, a huge embarrassment.
transcript.zh_text: 这是一个巨大的风险，如果失败，将是巨大的尴尬。

transcript.en_text: The embarrassment will be entirely my own. This is on my shoulders.
transcript.zh_text: 尴尬将完全由我自己承担。这是在我的肩膀上。

transcript.en_text: Even so, the president is gonna require some serious persuasion.
transcript.zh_text: 即便如此，总统仍需要认真的说服。

transcript.en_text: - I'm happy to talk to him. - No.
transcript.zh_text: - 我很高兴和他说话。- 不。

transcript.en_text: No... I'll do it.
transcript.zh_text: 不...我会做的。

transcript.en_text: He'll be more amenable if it comes from a friend.
transcript.zh_text: 如果是朋友的话，他会更顺从。

transcript.en_text: You're right. A trusted confidant.
transcript.zh_text: 你说得对。值得信赖的知己。

transcript.en_text: Let me test the waters.
transcript.zh_text: 让我试水一下。

transcript.en_text: The Cult of Tusk. one.
transcript.zh_text: 图斯克崇拜。一。

transcript.en_text: But that one disciple just so happens to be the most powerful man in the free world. For now.
transcript.zh_text: 但那一位弟子，恰好是自由世界最强大的人。目前。

transcript.en_text: Entitlements. Raising the age of eligibility to 67.
transcript.zh_text: 权利。将资格年龄提高至67岁。

transcript.en_text: Your people will never go for it.
transcript.zh_text: 你的人民永远不会这么做。

transcript.en_text: They will if the leadership does, and the leadership will.
transcript.zh_text: 如果领导层这样做，他们就会这样做，领导层也会这样做。

transcript.en_text: They've fought us on this since I was in diapers.
transcript.zh_text: 自从我穿尿布以来，他们就一直在这个问题上与我们斗争。

transcript.en_text: Assuming that I can get this past my people and convince them, - can you convince yours? - It's a tough sell.
transcript.zh_text: 假设我能说服我的员工并说服他们，-你能说服你的员工吗？- 这是一个艰难的销售。

transcript.en_text: You're the Senate majority leader, Hector. You don't have to sell, you can dictate.
transcript.zh_text: 你是参议院多数党领袖，赫克托。你不必出售，你可以发号施令。

transcript.en_text: - What do you want in return? - A working government.
transcript.zh_text: - 你想要什么回报？- 一个运转良好的政府。

transcript.en_text: - We stave off the freeze. - You won on education, we confirmed you as vice president.
transcript.zh_text: - 我们避开了冻结。- 你在教育方面获胜，我们确认你为副总统。

transcript.en_text: - The Republicans need a win, Frank. - And that's what I'm offering.
transcript.zh_text: - 共和党需要胜利，弗兰克。- 这就是我所提供的。

transcript.en_text: You get a win on entitlements, we avoid a shutdown.
transcript.zh_text: 您赢得了权利，我们避免了停工。

transcript.en_text: Everyone gets points for bipartisanship.
transcript.zh_text: 每个人都因两党合作而得分。

transcript.en_text: - You know who I'm worried about? - Curtis Haas.
transcript.zh_text: - 你知道我担心谁吗？- 柯蒂斯·哈斯。

transcript.en_text: - He's a troublemaker, Frank. - Who controls a third of your caucus.
transcript.zh_text: - 他是个麻烦制造者，弗兰克。- 谁控制着你们党团的三分之一。

transcript.en_text: And he'll never go for this. He wants to see the Democrats suffer.
transcript.zh_text: 他永远不会这样做。他希望看到民主党受苦。

transcript.en_text: Just bring him to the table. That's all I'm asking.
transcript.zh_text: 只要把他带到桌子上就可以了。这就是我要问的。

transcript.en_text: Miss Gallagher? My name is Lucas Goodwin, I'm a deputy editor of the Washington Herald.
transcript.zh_text: 加拉格尔小姐？我叫卢卡斯·古德温，是《华盛顿先驱报》的副主编。

transcript.en_text: - Mr. Goodwin, please. - Just a few moments, - that's all I'm asking. - If I wanted to talk to you, - I would've returned your calls. - Did you read my e-mails?
transcript.zh_text: - 古德温先生，有请。- 稍等一下， - 这就是我所要求的。- 如果我想和你说话， - 我会回你的电话。- 你读过我的电子邮件了吗？

transcript.en_text: Yes. Which is why I didn't call.
transcript.zh_text: 是的。这就是我没有打电话的原因。

transcript.en_text: Give me a chance to walk you through it.
transcript.zh_text: 给我一个机会引导您完成它。

transcript.en_text: I have to get back to the White House.
transcript.zh_text: 我必须回白宫。

transcript.en_text: - Peter Russo was killed. - Let go.
transcript.zh_text: - 彼得·罗素被杀。- 松手。

transcript.en_text: So was Zoe Barnes. I was working with her.
transcript.zh_text: 佐伊·巴恩斯也是如此。我和她一起工作。

transcript.en_text: - Stop and listen. - Frank Underwood is the one who did this.
transcript.zh_text: - 停下来听听。- 弗兰克·安德伍德就是这样做的人。

transcript.en_text: Listen! This is nuts.
transcript.zh_text: 听！这太疯狂了。

transcript.en_text: - The DUI, the brachiums. All of it... - This has to stop. OK?
transcript.zh_text: - 酒后驾车，上臂。所有这一切... - 这必须停止。好的？

transcript.en_text: Underwood talk to you? Tell you not to speak with anybody?
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德跟你说话吗？叫你不要和任何人说话？

transcript.en_text: - No. - Doug Stamper?
transcript.zh_text: - 不。 - 道格·斯坦普？

transcript.en_text: Whatever you think happened, whatever compelled you to stalk me like this...
transcript.zh_text: 无论你认为发生了什么，无论是什么迫使你这样跟踪我......

transcript.en_text: You're the only person who might know something, who could understand.
transcript.zh_text: 你是唯一可能知道某些事情、能够理解某些事情的人。

transcript.en_text: I've got no one else I can talk...
transcript.zh_text: 我没有其他人可以说话...

transcript.en_text: I don't understand. And I don't want to. OK?
transcript.zh_text: 我不明白。我不想。好的？

transcript.en_text: - There's no story here. - Please, five minutes.
transcript.zh_text: - 这里没有故事。- 拜托，五分钟。

transcript.en_text: Think about what you're doing. Waiting outside...
transcript.zh_text: 想想你在做什么。在外面等候...

transcript.en_text: Peter would be alive if it wasn't for Frank Underwood.
transcript.zh_text: 如果没有弗兰克·安德伍德，彼得可能还活着。

transcript.en_text: I've worked really hard to put Peter behind me.
transcript.zh_text: 我真的很努力地把彼得抛在身后。

transcript.en_text: So if I see you again, if I hear from you again, I'll not only contact the police, I'll let the vice president know what you're saying, and then you can deal with the Secret Service, too.
transcript.zh_text: 所以如果我再次见到你，如果我再次收到你的消息，我不仅会联系警察，我会让副总统知道你在说什么，然后你也可以与特勤局打交道。

transcript.en_text: It's the usual overseas chatter.
transcript.zh_text: 这是国外常见的闲话。

transcript.en_text: A bit of a bump in China, but we chalk that up to the trade tensions.
transcript.zh_text: 中国出现了一些冲击，但我们将其归因于贸易紧张局势。

transcript.en_text: - Secret Service? - Average number of death threats to both POTUS and the VP.
transcript.zh_text: - 特勤局？- 对总统和副总统的死亡威胁的平均数量。

transcript.en_text: We passed them along to our dear friends at the FBI.
transcript.zh_text: 我们将它们转交给联邦调查局的亲爱的朋友们。

transcript.en_text: FBI?
transcript.zh_text: 联邦调查局？

transcript.en_text: The FBI confirms the level of activity of our dear friends at the Secret Service.
transcript.zh_text: 联邦调查局确认了我们亲爱的朋友在特勤局的活动水平。

transcript.en_text: We've followed up on everything. No high-level threats.
transcript.zh_text: 我们已经跟进了一切。没有高级别的威胁。

transcript.en_text: So nothing we need to report directly to the president or vice president?
transcript.zh_text: 那么我们不需要直接向总统或副总统报告吗？

transcript.en_text: - No. - Thank you, gentlemen.
transcript.zh_text: - 不。 - 谢谢你们，先生们。

transcript.en_text: The e-mail you sent, has anyone else seen it?
transcript.zh_text: 您发送的电子邮件，其他人看到了吗？

transcript.en_text: Except for the agent that alerted me, no.
transcript.zh_text: 除了提醒我的代理人之外，没有。

transcript.en_text: Other agencies might have stumbled upon this.
transcript.zh_text: 其他机构可能偶然发现了这一点。

transcript.en_text: Even so, they probably ignored it.
transcript.zh_text: 即便如此，他们可能也忽略了这一点。

transcript.en_text: Any idea who's making the posts?
transcript.zh_text: 知道谁在发帖子吗？

transcript.en_text: Deep Web forums. Almost impossible to trace. Lone wolf, most likely.
transcript.zh_text: 深网论坛。几乎无法追踪。独狼，很有可能。

transcript.en_text: - I want you to find him. - We need a direct threat to life.
transcript.zh_text: - 我要你找到他。- 我们需要对生命的直接威胁。

transcript.en_text: The vice president just assumed office.
transcript.zh_text: 副总统刚刚上任。

transcript.en_text: I can't have this conspiracy stuff going mainstream.
transcript.zh_text: 我不能让这种阴谋论成为主流。

transcript.en_text: - This sort of thing usually fizzles out. - I can't take the chance.
transcript.zh_text: ——这种事情通常都会以失败告终。- 我不能抓住这个机会。

transcript.en_text: I want you to find him and put him away.
transcript.zh_text: 我要你找到他并把他带走。

transcript.en_text: - He hasn't committed a crime. - But he wants to.
transcript.zh_text: - 他没有犯罪。- 但他想要。

transcript.en_text: - So help him. - That requires manpower.
transcript.zh_text: - 所以帮助他吧。- 这需要人力。

transcript.en_text: - You've got men. - It exposes me, Doug.
transcript.zh_text: - 你有男人。- 它暴露了我，道格。

transcript.en_text: I've always kept you informed because you're an old pal and I trust you.
transcript.zh_text: 我总是让你了解情况，因为你是我的老朋友而且我信任你。

transcript.en_text: But...
We're talking about an operation.
transcript.zh_text: 我们正在谈论手术。

transcript.en_text: I'm an old pal who now works at the White House.
transcript.zh_text: 我是一位老朋友，现在在白宫工作。

transcript.en_text: Between old pals, I've been stuck at the executive liaison for way too long.
transcript.zh_text: 在老朋友之间，我已经被困在执行联络处太久了。

transcript.zh_text: 您对您所在社区的学校可能发生大规模枪击事件有多担心？很大，有点，不是那么多，一点也不，不确定。

transcript.en_text: Sorry, she's on duty right now.
transcript.zh_text: 抱歉，她现在正在值班。

transcript.zh_text: - 这是她的女儿。- 等一下。

transcript.zh_text: 雷切尔？雷切尔？

transcript.en_text: Sweetheart, are you there? Please don't...
transcript.zh_text: 亲爱的，你在吗？请不要...

transcript.zh_text: - 你好？- 你好，杰伊先生，我叫雷切尔，我代表国家枪械教育中心致电。

transcript.en_text: Would you be able to speak with me briefly regarding firearm legislation and Second Amendment protection?
transcript.zh_text: 您能和我简单谈谈枪支立法和第二修正案保护吗？

transcript.en_text: So you're Willa's top choice.
transcript.zh_text: 所以你是威拉的首选。

transcript.en_text: Why should you be my husband's and my top choice?
transcript.zh_text: 为什么你应该成为我丈夫和我的首选？

transcript.en_text: Over the past ten years, the two of you combined have gotten less coverage than the average junior congressman from Nebraska.
transcript.zh_text: 在过去的十年里，你们两个加起来得到的报道比内布拉斯加州普通初级国会议员的报道还少。

transcript.en_text: - Well, we don't seek the spotlight. - I'm not suggesting you should.
transcript.zh_text: - 好吧，我们不寻求聚光灯。- 我并不是建议你应该这样做。

transcript.en_text: But am I correct in assuming that your husband will be an active vice president?
transcript.zh_text: 但我假设你的丈夫将成为一名现任副总统，对吗？

transcript.en_text: Well, it's harder to keep an active VP out of the press than in it, but it's possible if we give the media just enough to keep them from starving.
transcript.zh_text: 好吧，让一位活跃的副总裁远离媒体比在媒体中更难，但如果我们给媒体足够的支持，让他们免于挨饿，这是可能的。

transcript.en_text: - Where'd you grow up, Connor? - Texas. Just like you.
transcript.zh_text: - 你在哪里长大，康纳？- 德克萨斯州。就像你一样。

transcript.en_text: - Dallas? - Lubbock.
transcript.zh_text: - 达拉斯？- 拉伯克。

transcript.zh_text: 我比你们有更浓重的口音需要摆脱。

transcript.zh_text: - 你怎么知道我有一个？- 你们的第一次联合面试，是在 86 年，当你的丈夫竞选州议会议员时。

transcript.zh_text: 当我想要一份工作时，我会做作业。

transcript.zh_text: 我期待看到你的想法。

transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你，安德伍德夫人。

transcript.en_text: Thursday.
transcript.zh_text: 周四。

transcript.en_text: I don't see how this is a victory for us.
transcript.zh_text: 我不明白这对我们来说是怎样的胜利。

transcript.en_text: Our choices are the freeze, which the Democrats get blamed for, or...
transcript.zh_text: 我们的选择是冻结，民主党因此受到指责，或者……

transcript.en_text: - Not necessarily, the Republi... - Which we definitely get blamed for.
transcript.zh_text: - 不一定，共和国... - 我们肯定会因此受到指责。

transcript.en_text: - Or we offer them... - Entitlements, Frank?
transcript.zh_text: - 或者我们为他们提供... - 权利，弗兰克？

transcript.zh_text: 我们表明了立场。我们现在不能回头了。

transcript.zh_text: 我宁愿看到政府陷入停顿。

transcript.zh_text: 想想标题：“民主领导实施权利改革，避免冻结。”

transcript.zh_text: 我们表现​​出团结。我们提供进步。

transcript.zh_text: 让我们改变一些终生的保守派。

transcript.zh_text: - 我愿意。- 我不想为了让断头台倒下而拼尽全力。

transcript.zh_text: 你不会的。我的脖子就在你身边。

transcript.en_text: Come on!
transcript.zh_text: 快点！

transcript.zh_text: - 它没有我想要的那么进步。- 你的意思是激进的。

transcript.en_text: Raising retirement age to 67 makes entitlements solvent until 2055.
transcript.zh_text: 将退休年龄提高至 67 岁，使福利在 2055 年之前具有偿付能力。

transcript.en_text: And it saves us over a trillion dollars without a single penny of taxpayer income.
transcript.zh_text: 它为我们节省了超过万亿美元，而纳税人却没有得到一分钱的收入。

transcript.en_text: Sixty-eight would give us another 300 billion, and I'd like to eliminate early retirement.
transcript.zh_text: 68 岁会给我们另外 3000 亿，我想取消提前退休。

transcript.en_text: - Entirely? - Forget it.
transcript.zh_text: - 完全吗？- 忘了它。

transcript.en_text: What about... 68 and 64?
I have a responsibility to my constituents.
transcript.zh_text: 我对我的选民负有责任。

transcript.en_text: - I promised I wouldn't waver... - Are we really going to allow the tea party to determine fiscal legislation?
transcript.zh_text: - 我保证我不会动摇... - 我们真的要让茶党来决定财政立法吗？

transcript.en_text: - Never been beholden to the tea party. - Come on. You wouldn't have won reelection if their PACs hadn't dumped ten million into your campaign.
transcript.zh_text: - 从来没有受过茶会的影响。- 快点。如果他们的政治行动委员会没有向你的竞选活动投入一千万美元，你就不会赢得连任。

transcript.en_text: If their definition of budgetary conservatism happens to overlap with mine, - that's a function of... - Curtis, let's show some goodwill.
transcript.zh_text: 如果他们对预算保守主义的定义恰好与我的重叠， - 这是一个函数...... - 柯蒂斯，让我们表现出一些善意。

transcript.en_text: - Can you stomach 68 and 64? - Effective immediately?
transcript.zh_text: - 你能接受68和64吗？- 立即生效？

transcript.en_text: - Five years from now. - Not interested.
transcript.zh_text: - 五年后。- 不感兴趣。

transcript.en_text: We can't throw this on people without any warning.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不能在没有任何警告的情况下把它扔给人们。

transcript.en_text: - They need some time to digest. - I'm sorry, I just can't do it.
transcript.zh_text: - 他们需要一些时间来消化。- 对不起，我做不到。

transcript.en_text: OK, meet with your staff, consult with your colleagues, I'll consult with mine and let's talk tomorrow.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，与您的员工会面，与您的同事协商，我将与我的同事协商，我们明天再谈。

transcript.en_text: - All right. I can agree to that. - But this is a good first step.
transcript.zh_text: - 好的。我可以同意这一点。- 但这是良好的第一步。

transcript.en_text: How do we make sure Curtis can't filibuster - when we get the amendment passed? - Assuming we do.
transcript.zh_text: 当修正案获得通过时，我们如何确保柯蒂斯不会进行阻挠？- 假设我们这样做。

transcript.en_text: Between you and me, I'm sure we can turn him around.
transcript.zh_text: 在你我之间，我确信我们可以扭转他的局面。

transcript.en_text: I just want to be on the safe side.
transcript.zh_text: 我只是想确保安全。

transcript.en_text: Make sure the passage of the amendment - constitutes the passage of the bill. - By previous agreement.
transcript.zh_text: 确保修正案的通过——构成该法案的通过。- 根据先前的协议。

transcript.en_text: We pass the amendment, then we're done. Wham-bam.
transcript.zh_text: 我们通过了修正案，然后就完成了。嘭嘭。

transcript.en_text: - Can we put that in writing? - Have Erikson reach out to me.
transcript.zh_text: - 我们可以把它写下来吗？- 让埃里克森联系我。

transcript.en_text: "Muchas gracias."
transcript.zh_text: “太感谢了。”

transcript.en_text: Lucas Goodwin?
transcript.zh_text: 卢卡斯·古德温？

transcript.en_text: Good evening, Lucas.
transcript.zh_text: 晚上好，卢卡斯。

transcript.en_text: Speak into the microphone.
transcript.zh_text: 对着麦克风讲话。

transcript.en_text: - Who are you? -  Go to the home screen.
transcript.zh_text: - 你是谁？- 转到主屏幕。

transcript.en_text: - Open the other app. - Tell me who you are.
transcript.zh_text: - 打开另一个应用程序。- 告诉我你是谁。

transcript.en_text: You've done your research. You know who I am.
transcript.zh_text: 你已经完成了你的研究。你知道我是谁。

transcript.en_text: Well, I know who you claim to be.
transcript.zh_text: 好吧，我知道你自称是谁。

transcript.en_text: If you're not convinced by now, goodbye.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你现在还不相信，再见。

transcript.en_text: Wait a minute. Uh...
transcript.zh_text: 等一下。呃...

transcript.en_text: - All right, I'm on the home screen. -  Open the notary app.
transcript.zh_text: - 好吧，我在主屏幕上。- 打开公证应用程序。

transcript.en_text: What is this?
transcript.zh_text: 这是什么？

transcript.en_text: To ensure you aren't law enforcement.
transcript.zh_text: 确保你不是执法人员。

transcript.en_text: - I'm not. -  Then sign.
transcript.zh_text: - 我不是。- 然后签名。

transcript.en_text: - How? - Hold your thumb to the camera and press "capture."
transcript.zh_text: - 如何？- 将拇指放在相机上，然后按“拍摄”。

transcript.en_text: How do I know you're not law enforcement?
transcript.zh_text: 我怎么知道你不是执法人员？

transcript.en_text: Sign the document or walk away.
transcript.zh_text: 签署文件或走开。

transcript.en_text: All right. I did it.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。我做到了。

transcript.en_text: - Press "send." - Where is this going?
transcript.zh_text: - 按“发送”。- 这是要去哪里？

transcript.en_text: I'm VPNing through Iran and 12 other countries, don't worry. It's secure.
transcript.zh_text: 我正在通过伊朗和其他 12 个国家/地区使用 VPN，请放心。这是安全的。

transcript.en_text: Now, one last thing.
transcript.zh_text: 现在，最后一件事。

transcript.en_text: I need the two-step verification code for the Herald's internal servers.
transcript.zh_text: 我需要先驱报内部服务器的两步验证码。

transcript.en_text: - I don't even know how to do that.
transcript.zh_text: - 我什至不知道该怎么做。

transcript.en_text: -  Yes, you do. Check your e-mail.
transcript.zh_text: - 是的，你知道。检查您的电子邮件。

transcript.en_text: Destroy the iPad, especially the serial number, and delete the e-mail after you've memorized it.
transcript.zh_text: 销毁 iPad，尤其是序列号，并在记住电子邮件后将其删除。

transcript.en_text: Good luck.
transcript.zh_text: 祝你好运。

transcript.en_text: Hello?
transcript.zh_text: 你好？

transcript.en_text: Raymond, are you there?
transcript.zh_text: 雷蒙德，你在吗？

transcript.en_text: Yeah, uh, sorry, Frank, I...
transcript.zh_text: 是的，呃，对不起，弗兰克，我...

transcript.en_text: I thought I saw an Inca dove.
transcript.zh_text: 我以为我看到了一只印加鸽子。

transcript.en_text: It must have flown the wrong direction for winter.
transcript.zh_text: 冬天它肯定飞错了方向。

transcript.en_text: - It sounds windy. Where are you? -  Top of my building.
transcript.zh_text: - 听起来有风。你在哪里？- 我的大楼顶部。

transcript.en_text: Got a bird feeder up here.
transcript.zh_text: 这里有一个喂鸟器。

transcript.en_text: Nice work with the president. I hear we have a green light.
transcript.zh_text: 与总统合作愉快。我听说我们已经绿灯了。

transcript.en_text: He pushed back in the beginning but, yeah, his writers are reworking the speech now.
transcript.zh_text: 他一开始就反对，但是，是的，他的编剧现在正在修改演讲。

transcript.en_text: I'm very close to a deal. Sixty-eight, 64 in five years.
transcript.zh_text: 我非常接近达成协议。六十八岁，五年后六十四岁。

transcript.en_text: - Spending cuts as discussed. - That rock solid?
transcript.zh_text: - 讨论的支出削减。- 坚如磐石吗？

transcript.en_text: - Soon as we shake hands. - What's the holdup?
transcript.zh_text: - 当我们握手时。- 有什么困难吗？

transcript.en_text: Curtis Haas, which isn't a surprise. I'm meeting with him soon.
transcript.zh_text: 柯蒂斯·哈斯，这并不奇怪。我很快就要和他见面了。

transcript.en_text: - He's the final hurdle. -  Cutting it pretty close, Frank.
transcript.zh_text: - 他是最后的障碍。- 非常接近，弗兰克。

transcript.en_text: Well, this is... this is historic.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，这是……这是历史性的。

transcript.en_text: The Republicans have wanted entitlement reform since Johnson.
transcript.zh_text: 自约翰逊以来，共和党人一直希望进行福利改革。

transcript.en_text: Curtis will come around. In the meantime, we should get the new retirement ages - into his speech. - I would stay away from specifics.
transcript.zh_text: 柯蒂斯会过来的。与此同时，我们应该将新的退休年龄纳入他的演讲中。- 我会远离细节。

transcript.en_text: - I mean, even if it passes, the House... - I know the House better than you know birds. Believe me when I say they'll pass the Senate version.
transcript.zh_text: - 我的意思是，即使它过去了，众议院... - 我对众议院的了解比你对鸟类的了解还要多。相信我，我说他们会通过参议院版本。

transcript.en_text: I'll talk to the president.
transcript.zh_text: 我会和总统谈谈。

transcript.en_text: - Just make sure this is airtight. - Thank you. What is it?
transcript.zh_text: - 只要确保这是密封的。- 谢谢。它是什么？

transcript.en_text: - Lucas Goodwin. - From the Herald?
transcript.zh_text: ——卢卡斯·古德温。- 来自先驱报？

transcript.en_text: He must have been working with Zoe.
transcript.zh_text: 他一定是在和佐伊一起工作。

transcript.en_text: - How much does he know? - No more than she did.
transcript.zh_text: - 他知道多少？- 不比她多。

transcript.en_text: - She knew enough. - I'm on it, sir.
transcript.zh_text: - 她知道得够多了。- 我正在处理，先生。

transcript.en_text: - Proof? - Not yet.
transcript.zh_text: - 证明？- 还没有。

transcript.en_text: - Jesus, Doug. - It's under control. I thought you should be aware.
transcript.zh_text: - 天哪，道格。- 一切都在控制之中。我想你应该知道。

transcript.en_text: I'm juggling the president, the Republicans, Tusk. I can't...
transcript.zh_text: 我正在与总统、共和党、图斯克周旋。我不能...

transcript.en_text: And you should stay focused on that. Goodwin's on my plate, not yours.
transcript.zh_text: 你应该专注于此。古德温是我的菜，不是你的。

transcript.en_text: It wasn't until the 20th century that the notion of noble objectivism came into the forefront.
transcript.zh_text: 直到20世纪，崇高客观主义的概念才出现在人们的视野中。

transcript.en_text: - But facts are facts. - Nineteen ninety-two.
transcript.zh_text: - 但事实就是事实。- 十九点九十二分。

transcript.en_text: George Bush Sr. is shown asking how a grocery scanner works, and he gets nailed for it. they were showing him a new model.
transcript.zh_text: 老布什询问杂货扫描仪的工作原理，结果他被钉住了。他们正在向他展示一个新模型。

transcript.en_text: He was asking how the new one was different than the old one.
transcript.zh_text: 他问新的和旧的有什么不同。

transcript.en_text: Curiosity, not ignorance.
transcript.zh_text: 好奇心，而不是无知。

transcript.en_text: But the lack of context told a more powerful narrative.
transcript.zh_text: 但缺乏背景却讲述了更有力的叙述。

transcript.en_text: There is no arrangement of facts that is purely objective.
transcript.zh_text: 不存在纯粹客观的事实安排。

transcript.en_text: We can finally do something. We have the means to act.
transcript.zh_text: 我们终于可以做点什么了。我们有能力采取行动。

transcript.en_text: Some teenage, pimple-faced hacker...
transcript.zh_text: 一些满脸痘痘的青少年黑客……

transcript.en_text: This was a sophisticated infiltration.
transcript.zh_text: 这是一次复杂的渗透。

transcript.en_text: It's not the work of a child. Look, here's the e-mail.
transcript.zh_text: 这不是一个孩子的工作。看，这是电子邮件。

transcript.en_text: "Heronymous Bot." The FBI's been hunting him for years.
transcript.zh_text: “赫名机器人。”联邦调查局多年来一直在追捕他。

transcript.en_text: - Listen to me... - If we get these records, I'll need your help tracking timelines, piecing together...
transcript.zh_text: - 听我说... - 如果我们得到这些记录，我需要你帮助跟踪时间线，拼凑起来...

transcript.en_text: No! You want somebody to hold your hand and say it's OK to go on this fucking goose chase.
transcript.zh_text: 不！你希望有人握住你的手，告诉你可以继续这个该死的无聊的追逐。

transcript.en_text: You shouldn't be teaching in Ithaca. You're better than that.
transcript.zh_text: 你不应该在伊萨卡教书。你比那更好。

transcript.en_text: - You should be back... - I belong here.
transcript.zh_text: - 你应该回来... - 我属于这里。

transcript.en_text: Droning on to a bunch of hung over English majors?
transcript.zh_text: 正在听一群悬着的英语专业学生的课吗？

transcript.en_text: - Exactly. - You're wrong about the truth.
transcript.zh_text: - 确切地。- 你对事实的看法是错误的。

transcript.en_text: There is objective truth. He killed her.
transcript.zh_text: 有客观真理。他杀了她。

transcript.en_text: You know it's a fact.
transcript.zh_text: 你知道这是事实。

transcript.en_text: Here's a fact: my mom has ten, 15 years left at best.
transcript.zh_text: 事实是：我妈妈最多还有十年、十五年的寿命。

transcript.en_text: I've seen her more in the past month than since I left for school.
transcript.zh_text: 过去一个月我见到她的次数比我去上学以来见到她的次数还多。

transcript.en_text: It's simpler here. It's quiet. I need that. She needs me.
transcript.zh_text: 这里更简单。很安静。我需要那个。她需要我。

transcript.en_text: I'm sorry, Lucas. I'm sorry that night how I reacted.
transcript.zh_text: 对不起，卢卡斯。我很抱歉那天晚上我的反应。

transcript.en_text: I'm sorry you lost your girlfriend.
transcript.zh_text: 我很遗憾你失去了你的女朋友。

transcript.en_text: I'm sorry the world is this fucked up.
transcript.zh_text: 对不起，这个世界已经这么乱了。

transcript.en_text: I really am.
transcript.zh_text: 我确实是。

transcript.en_text: But I can't help you.
transcript.zh_text: 但我帮不了你。

transcript.en_text: Thank you.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢。

transcript.en_text: - Where's everyone else? - I did you a disservice yesterday.
transcript.zh_text: - 其他人都在哪里？- 我昨天伤害了你。

transcript.en_text: We shouldn't have put you on the spot in front of all the leadership.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不应该让你站在所有领导面前。

transcript.en_text: Have a seat, Curtis.
transcript.zh_text: 坐吧，柯蒂斯。

transcript.en_text: We know that you have an obligation to take a firm stance, but entitlement reform is something you ran on, and now it's within your grasp.
transcript.zh_text: 我们知道你们有义务采取坚定的立场，但权利改革是你们所追求的，现在它就在你们的掌握之中。

transcript.en_text: So tell us your fears.
transcript.zh_text: 那么请告诉我们您的恐惧。

transcript.en_text: That the Democrats get another win.
transcript.zh_text: 民主党再次获胜。

transcript.en_text: We suffer in the midterms and the next Congress dismantles the agreement.
transcript.zh_text: 我们在中期选举中遭受苦难，下一届国会废除了该协议。

transcript.en_text: You think we're being disingenuous.
transcript.zh_text: 你认为我们不诚实。

transcript.en_text: My constituents don't trust the administration.
transcript.zh_text: 我的选民不信任政府。

transcript.en_text: I can't have them thinking the wool has been pulled over our eyes.
transcript.zh_text: 我不能让他们认为我们被蒙蔽了。

transcript.en_text: As I suspected. Hector?
transcript.zh_text: 正如我所怀疑的。赫克托？

transcript.en_text: Frank and I propose this: we include a super majority point of order against revisiting the issue for ten years.
transcript.zh_text: 弗兰克和我提议：我们制定绝对多数议事规则，禁止在十年内重新讨论这个问题。

transcript.en_text: You'll have it in black-and-white. A serious, long-term commitment with no opportunity to dismantle.
transcript.zh_text: 你会得到黑白的。严肃、长期的承诺，没有机会撤销。

transcript.en_text: That's on top of everything else we asked for.
transcript.zh_text: 这是我们要求的一切之上的。

transcript.en_text: VA services and FEMA stay at current levels.
transcript.zh_text: VA 服务和 FEMA 保持在当前水平。

transcript.en_text: Everything else at 80 to a hundred percent of the cuts you propose.
transcript.zh_text: 其他一切都按照你建议的百分之八十到一百的削减。

transcript.en_text: You get your win, Curtis. We just avoid disaster.
transcript.zh_text: 你赢了，柯蒂斯。我们只是避免灾难。

transcript.en_text: Maybe the country needs to see what disaster looks like.
transcript.zh_text: 也许这个国家需要看看灾难是什么样子的。

transcript.en_text: The tea party is a strong voice, and you're its bullhorn.
transcript.zh_text: 茶党是一个强有力的声音，而你就是它的扩音器。

transcript.en_text: Show your people that voice can translate into law, and not just add to the noise.
transcript.zh_text: 向您的员工表明，声音可以转化为法律，而不仅仅是增加噪音。

transcript.en_text: Fifteen years before revisitation, not ten.
transcript.zh_text: 重访前十五年，而不是十年。

transcript.en_text: - OK. - And if the House fails to pass the bill after we do, you go on record blaming your own party for the gridlock.
transcript.zh_text: - 好的。- 如果众议院在我们之后未能通过该法案，你就会公开指责你自己的政党造成了僵局。

transcript.en_text: I believe we have a deal.
transcript.zh_text: 我相信我们达成协议了

transcript.zh_text: 你在听什么？

transcript.en_text: - Sorry. I'll turn it down. - No, it's nice.
transcript.zh_text: - 对不起。我会把它关掉。- 不，这很好。

transcript.en_text: Can I listen?
transcript.zh_text: 我可以听吗？

transcript.en_text: My ears are clean, I promise.
transcript.zh_text: 我保证，我的耳朵是干净的。

transcript.en_text: OK.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。

transcript.en_text: Thanks.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢。

transcript.en_text: - It's beautiful. - Yeah.
transcript.zh_text: - 很美丽。- 是的。

transcript.en_text: - It's so sad. - It helps me relax.
transcript.zh_text: - 太难过了。- 它帮助我放松。

transcript.en_text: Long day?
transcript.zh_text: 漫长的一天？

transcript.en_text: I work at a call center. So yeah.
transcript.zh_text: 我在呼叫中心工作。所以是的。

transcript.en_text: Two hundred strangers an hour.
transcript.zh_text: 每小时两百个陌生人。

transcript.en_text: I'll leave you alone. You probably don't want to talk to another one.
transcript.zh_text: 我会让你独自一人。您可能不想与另一个人交谈。

transcript.en_text: It's all right. As long as you don't hang up on me.
transcript.zh_text: 没关系。只要你不挂断我的电话。

transcript.en_text: Do you ever just talk to them? The strangers?
transcript.zh_text: 你只是和他们说话吗？陌生人？

transcript.en_text: - We're not allowed to. - All I would want to do is ask them about who they are.
transcript.zh_text: - 我们不被允许这样做。- 我只想问他们是谁。

transcript.en_text: What about you? What do you do?
transcript.zh_text: 你呢？你做什么工作？

transcript.en_text: I... I work at the bookstore, at the day-care center.
transcript.zh_text: 我...我在书店、日托中心工作。

transcript.en_text: I had that same look on my face the first time somebody handed me one of those.
transcript.zh_text: 当有人第一次递给我其中一个时，我的脸上也有同样的表情。

transcript.en_text: - I'm just... I'm not religious. - Just keep it.
transcript.zh_text: - 我只是...我不信教。- 保留它。

transcript.en_text: Check it out. Or don't.
transcript.zh_text: 一探究竟。或者不这样做。

transcript.en_text: We've got really good music there.
transcript.zh_text: 我们那里有非常好的音乐。

transcript.en_text: Thank you.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢。

transcript.zh_text: The House sent a bill to the Senate.弗兰克想要发回的东西相似度为零。

transcript.en_text: Because it's bipartisan, unlike ours.
transcript.zh_text: 因为它是两党合作的，与我们不同。

transcript.en_text: That sounds like something Frank would say.
transcript.zh_text: 这听起来像是弗兰克会说的话。

transcript.en_text: - I'm not Frank. - He has a desk in your office.
transcript.zh_text: - 我不是弗兰克。- 他在你的办公室里有一张桌子。

transcript.en_text: - If this bill passes in the Senate... - It won't.
transcript.zh_text: - 如果这项法案在参议院获得通过... - 不会的

transcript.zh_text: 我们应该做好准备，鲍勃。

transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我准备等着瞧。

transcript.zh_text: 女士们，下午好。

transcript.en_text: - Ladies? - He's threatened.
transcript.zh_text: - 女士们？- 他受到威胁了

transcript.en_text: - He's a pig. - Give him time. He used to have two white, middle-aged guys at his side. Now he's got a black guy and a woman 20 years his junior.
transcript.zh_text: - 他是头猪。- 给他时间。他身边曾经有两个白人中年男子。现在他有一个黑人和一个比他小20岁的女人。

transcript.en_text: Who knows how to shoot a rifle.
transcript.zh_text: 谁知道如何用步枪射击。

transcript.en_text: We just need to keep at him.
transcript.zh_text: 我们只需要继续关注他。

transcript.en_text: - Yes? - Catalina Rodriguez is on line four.
transcript.zh_text: - 是的？- Catalina Rodriguez 在四号线。

transcript.en_text: Give me a moment.
transcript.zh_text: 给我一点时间。

transcript.en_text: - Catalina. - Ted told me it was you.
transcript.zh_text: - 卡塔利娜。- 特德告诉我是你。

transcript.en_text: -  You there? - Yes. I'm here.
transcript.zh_text: -  你在那里？- 是的。我在这儿。

transcript.en_text: The press won't leave us alone. For weeks.
transcript.zh_text: 媒体不会放过我们。持续数周。

transcript.en_text: They're showing up, trying to get pictures of me and Emily.
transcript.zh_text: 他们出现了，想给我和艾米丽拍张照片。

transcript.en_text: - It wasn't me. -  You're the only one who knew.
transcript.zh_text: - 这不是我。- 你是唯一知道的人。

transcript.en_text: - I don't know how the story got out. -  Why would Ted lie about that?
transcript.zh_text: - 我不知道这个故事是怎么流传出来的。- 特德为什么要撒谎？

transcript.en_text: I don't know. Maybe... maybe he's ashamed.
transcript.zh_text: 我不知道。也许……也许他感到羞耻。

transcript.en_text: So, what do I do? When will they leave us alone?
transcript.zh_text: 那么，我该怎么办？他们什么时候才会放过我们？

transcript.en_text: I... I don't know, Catalina.
transcript.zh_text: 我……我不知道，卡塔利娜。

transcript.en_text: I can't live like this.
transcript.zh_text: 我不能这样生活。

transcript.en_text: I'm... I'm sorry. I don't know what to say.
transcript.zh_text: 我……对不起。我不知道该说什么。

transcript.en_text: How... how is Emily doing?
transcript.zh_text: 艾米丽……怎么样？

transcript.en_text: Catalina?
transcript.zh_text: 卡塔利娜？

transcript.en_text: - He's very confident. - Yeah, but does he have what it takes?
transcript.zh_text: - 他非常有信心。- 是的，但是他有能力吗？

transcript.en_text: - We'll see when I get his media plan. - What about his personality?
transcript.zh_text: - 当我收到他的媒体计划时我们会看到。- 他的性格怎么样？

transcript.en_text: Charming. Direct. Very thorough.
transcript.zh_text: 迷人。直接的。非常彻底。

transcript.en_text: He found our first interview together, in '86.
transcript.zh_text: 他发现我们第一次一起接受采访是在 86 年。

transcript.en_text: I would love to see that. Does he have a copy?
transcript.zh_text: 我很想看到这一点。他有副本吗？

transcript.en_text: I don't think so. The TV station made him watch it there.
transcript.zh_text: 我不这么认为。电视台让他在那里看。

transcript.en_text: We should screen that for the president and the First Lady.
transcript.zh_text: 我们应该为总统和第一夫人筛选这一点。

transcript.en_text: - Show 'em how it's done. - Christina.
transcript.zh_text: - 向他们展示它是如何完成的。- 克里斯蒂娜。

transcript.en_text: - What about her? - Have you noticed anything strange - between her and the president? - How do you mean?
transcript.zh_text: - 她呢？- 你有没有注意到她和总统之间有什么奇怪的事情？- 你是什么意思？

transcript.en_text: I passed them in the hall yesterday.
transcript.zh_text: 昨天我在大厅里经过他们。

transcript.en_text: They seem, I don't know... very intimate.
transcript.zh_text: 他们看起来，我不知道……非常亲密。

transcript.en_text: They did seem cozy at the prep session.
transcript.zh_text: 他们在准备阶段确实看起来很舒服。

transcript.en_text: - Do you think...? - No. Not necessarily.
transcript.zh_text: - 你认为...？- 不，不一定。

transcript.en_text: An interesting thought, though.
transcript.zh_text: 不过，这是一个有趣的想法。

transcript.en_text: - Sorry to interrupt, sir. - We're having lunch.
transcript.zh_text: - 抱歉打扰了，先生。- 我们正在吃午饭。

transcript.en_text: The Republicans are backing out. Mendoza's chief of staff just gave me the heads up.
transcript.zh_text: 共和党正在退出。门多萨的幕僚长刚刚向我发出了警告。

transcript.en_text: - Get Mendoza on the phone. - It's Curtis Haas. He got cold feet.
transcript.zh_text: - 给门多萨打电话。- 我是柯蒂斯·哈斯。他临阵退缩了。

transcript.en_text: Too many cages. It's really... kind of inconvenient, but, you know, people look at them. It's kind of funny. And...
transcript.zh_text: 笼子太多了。这确实……有点不方便，但是，你知道，人们会看着它们。这有点好笑。和...

transcript.en_text: - I got your e-mail. - Now good for you?
transcript.zh_text: - 我收到了你的电子邮件。- 现在对你有好处吗？

transcript.en_text: Yeah, sure. Can I call you right back?
transcript.zh_text: 是的，当然。我可以马上给你回电话吗？

transcript.en_text: What exactly did you need to know?
transcript.zh_text: 您到底需要知道什么？

transcript.en_text: We're doing some follow-up pieces on the cyberwarfare thing.
transcript.zh_text: 我们正在做一些关于网络战的后续工作。

transcript.en_text: I just wanted to get a layman's understanding of how the Chinese might get through a firewall.
transcript.zh_text: 我只是想让外行人了解中国人如何穿过防火墙。

transcript.en_text: It's a bit complicated, but I can show you the basics.
transcript.zh_text: 这有点复杂，但我可以向您展示基础知识。

transcript.en_text: That's all I need.
transcript.zh_text: 这就是我所需要的。

transcript.en_text: We use a standard N-tier architecture.
transcript.zh_text: 我们使用标准的 N 层架构。

transcript.en_text: Think of it like a big sandwich, with layers of bread.
transcript.zh_text: 把它想象成一个大三明治，里面有多层面包。

transcript.en_text: Between each is the lettuce, the tomato, the roast beef, you know, whatever.
transcript.zh_text: 每道菜之间都是生菜、番茄、烤牛肉，等等。

transcript.en_text: What I'm pulling up here is the org code which separates the database...
transcript.zh_text: 我在这里提取的是分隔数据库的组织代码......

transcript.en_text: Shit, I forgot there's a meeting with sales in a couple minutes.
transcript.zh_text: 糟糕，我忘了几分钟后就要开销售会议了。

transcript.en_text: - You wanna do this later? - No, I'll just run over and let them know I'll be a few minutes late. Be right back.
transcript.zh_text: - 你想稍后再做吗？- 不，我会跑过去告诉他们我会迟到几分钟。马上回来。

transcript.en_text: Cool. I'll be here.
transcript.zh_text: 凉爽的。我会在这里。

transcript.en_text: Come on, come on, come on, come on.
transcript.zh_text: 来吧，来吧，来吧，来吧。

transcript.en_text: Yeah.
transcript.zh_text: 是的。

transcript.en_text: Come on.
transcript.zh_text: 快点。

transcript.en_text: OK.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。

transcript.en_text: Delete. Go.
transcript.zh_text: 删除。去。

transcript.en_text: - Something wrong? - Can't find my phone.
transcript.zh_text: - 有事吗？- 找不到我的手机。

transcript.en_text: It's weird, I had it a minute ago.
transcript.zh_text: 很奇怪，我一分钟前就有了。

transcript.en_text: Oh!
transcript.zh_text: 哦！

transcript.en_text: - Here it is. Sorry about that. - No problem.
transcript.zh_text: - 这里是。对此感到抱歉。- 没问题。

transcript.en_text: So the N-tier architecture, the hi-tech sandwich I was talking about....
transcript.zh_text: 所以 N 层架构，我正在谈论的高科技三明治......

transcript.en_text: I thought Mendoza was willing to work with us.
transcript.zh_text: 我认为门多萨愿意与我们合作。

transcript.en_text: He is. The problem is Curtis Haas.
transcript.zh_text: 他是。问题出在柯蒂斯·哈斯身上。

transcript.en_text: - And have you spoken with him? - His office isn't returning our calls.
transcript.zh_text: - 你和他谈过了吗？- 他的办公室没有回复我们的电话。

transcript.en_text: - Neither is Mendoza's, but... - I should've stuck to my guns.
transcript.zh_text: - 门多萨的也不是，但是... - 我应该坚持我的立场。

transcript.en_text: The vote isn't until tomorrow afternoon. I'll reach out to Mendoza...
transcript.zh_text: 投票要到明天下午才进行。我会联系门多萨...

transcript.en_text: This is the State of the Union, Frank. I won't be left in limbo.
transcript.zh_text: 这是国情咨文，弗兰克。我不会陷入困境。

transcript.en_text: If we need to start rewriting that speech now, I don't want to waste a minute.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我们现在需要开始重写那篇演讲稿，我不想浪费一分钟。

transcript.en_text: I can turn this around, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 我可以扭转局面，先生。

transcript.en_text: Raymond told me this was your idea, to pursue this compromise.
transcript.zh_text: 雷蒙德告诉我，这是你的想法，追求这种妥协。

transcript.en_text: - I suggested it as an option. - No, he said you bullied him into it.
transcript.zh_text: - 我建议它作为一个选项。- 不，他说你欺负他了。

transcript.en_text: That he thought it was a mistake.
transcript.zh_text: 他认为这是一个错误。

transcript.en_text: If he felt so strongly, he should've have advised you otherwise.
transcript.zh_text: 如果他的感觉如此强烈，他应该早就给你建议了。

transcript.en_text: Raymond's not a politician. He relies on our political expertise as much as we rely on his business acumen.
transcript.zh_text: 雷蒙德不是政治家。他依赖我们的政治专业知识，就像我们依赖他的商业头脑一样。

transcript.en_text: Maybe we shouldn't point fingers until there's a problem.
transcript.zh_text: 也许我们不应该在出现问题之前指责别人。

transcript.en_text: - You wouldn't call this a problem? - Not if it's solved before it becomes one.
transcript.zh_text: - 你不会认为这是一个问题吗？- 如果在它成为一个问题之前就解决了，那就不行了。

transcript.en_text: You see, I wanted a vice president who can manage Congress, not one who bites off more than he can chew.
transcript.zh_text: 你看，我想要一位能够管理国会的副总统，而不是一位贪多嚼不烂的人。

transcript.en_text: Then have faith you made the right choice, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 那么请相信您做出了正确的选择，先生。

transcript.en_text: Whatever faith I have... is quickly evaporating.
transcript.zh_text: 无论我有什么信仰……都很快就会消失。

transcript.en_text: Don't humiliate the administration, Frank. You're part of it now.
transcript.zh_text: 不要羞辱政府，弗兰克。你现在是其中的一部分了。

transcript.en_text: - Yes, sir. - We're done.
transcript.zh_text: - 是的，先生。- 我们完成了。

transcript.en_text: Thank you, Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢总统先生。

transcript.en_text: Give me the private line, please.
transcript.zh_text: 请给我私人线路。

transcript.en_text: Tusk is blocking my way. Goodwin at my heels.
transcript.zh_text: 图斯克挡住了我的路。古德温紧随我后。

transcript.en_text: There can be no false steps now.
transcript.zh_text: 现在不能有任何错误的步骤。

transcript.en_text: The higher up the mountain, the more treacherous the path.
transcript.zh_text: 山越高，路就越险峻。

transcript.en_text: Lucas Goodwin went up to visit her.
transcript.zh_text: 卢卡斯·古德温上前去看望她。

transcript.en_text: - They may be looking for you. - Nobody's contacted me.
transcript.zh_text: - 他们可能正在找你。- 没有人联系我。

transcript.en_text: I don't think anyone knows I'm here.
transcript.zh_text: 我想没有人知道我在这里。

transcript.en_text: We need to make sure it stays that way.
transcript.zh_text: 我们需要确保它保持这种状态。

transcript.en_text: Don't speak to anyone you don't have to. Don't go anywhere you don't need to be.
transcript.zh_text: 不必要时不要与任何人说话。不要去任何你不需要去的地方。

transcript.en_text: - Tell me you heard what I said. - I heard you. I get it.
transcript.zh_text: - 告诉我你听到我说的话了。- 我听到了。我得到它。

transcript.en_text: I'm fine.
transcript.zh_text: 我很好。

transcript.en_text: - Let me put some ice on it. - I said it's OK.
transcript.zh_text: - 让我在上面放些冰块。- 我说没关系。

transcript.en_text: What is this?
transcript.zh_text: 这是什么？

transcript.en_text: What, are you going through my garbage now?
transcript.zh_text: 怎么，你现在在翻我的垃圾吗？

transcript.en_text: Someone gave it to me on the bus.
transcript.zh_text: 有人在公交车上给我的。

transcript.en_text: You let me know if anyone contacts you.
transcript.zh_text: 如果有人联系你请告诉我。

transcript.en_text: - Hey. - Hey. Sorry I'm late.
transcript.zh_text: - 嘿。- 嘿。抱歉我来晚了。

transcript.en_text: No worries.
transcript.zh_text: 不用担心。

transcript.en_text: How much more you wanna do right now? Fill in this area?
transcript.zh_text: 现在你还想做多少事？填写该区域？

transcript.en_text: Yeah, and one more poppy down here.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，这里还有一朵罂粟花。

transcript.en_text: - That's a lot for one sitting. - I know.
transcript.zh_text: - 一坐就这么多了。- 我知道。

transcript.en_text: OK.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。

transcript.en_text: Francis?
transcript.zh_text: 弗朗西斯？

transcript.en_text: - You're heading in? - Mendoza's an early riser.
transcript.zh_text: - 你要进去吗？- 门多萨是一个早起的人。

transcript.en_text: - You'll figure this out. - I need to prove what the vice president is capable of.
transcript.zh_text: - 你会明白这一点的。- 我需要证明副总统的能力。

transcript.en_text: Don't prove it to them. Prove it to me.
transcript.zh_text: 不要向他们证明这一点。向我证明一下。

transcript.en_text: Curtis has me by the tea bags, Frank. I don't have a working majority without him.
transcript.zh_text: 柯蒂斯让我拿着茶包，弗兰克。没有他，我就没有工作多数。

transcript.en_text: - He wasn't elected leader. - True. But I have to pick my battles.
transcript.zh_text: - 他没有当选领导人。- 真的。但我必须选择我的战斗。

transcript.en_text: If you can't control him on budgetary issues...
transcript.zh_text: 如果你不能在预算问题上控制他......

transcript.en_text: It's not just him. It's the 15 senators he has under his thumb.
transcript.zh_text: 不只是他。这是他手下的 15 名参议员。

transcript.en_text: I won't be the leader next year if they turn on me.
transcript.zh_text: 如果他们攻击我的话，明年我就不会成为领导者了。

transcript.en_text: So he wants to be courted. Sit him down...
transcript.zh_text: 所以他想要被人追捧。让他坐下...

transcript.en_text: I already tried talking to him. He wouldn't budge.
transcript.zh_text: 我已经尝试和他说话了。他不肯让步。

transcript.en_text: - We'll both talk. - He's made his position clear.
transcript.zh_text: - 我们俩都会谈谈。- 他已经明确表明了自己的立场。

transcript.en_text: We all shook hands at this table.
transcript.zh_text: 我们都在这张桌子上握手。

transcript.en_text: The most I can do is put the substitute amendment on the floor with limited debate. And your people can say whatever they want for the record, but we're gonna vote the amendment down.
transcript.zh_text: 我最多能做的就是在有限的辩论中提出替代修正案。你们的人民可以畅所欲言，但我们将否决该修正案。

transcript.en_text: I'm not interested in symbolic gestures.
transcript.zh_text: 我对象征性的手势不感兴趣。

transcript.en_text: Well, that's all I can offer.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，这就是我能提供的。

transcript.en_text: - Where's your courage? - My power has limits, Frank.
transcript.zh_text: - 你的勇气在哪里？- 我的力量是有限度的，弗兰克。

transcript.en_text: Five Republicans makes you the deciding vote.
transcript.zh_text: 五位共和党人让你投下决定性一票。

transcript.en_text: Now, it's highly doubtful we can get them to vote against their own party.
transcript.zh_text: 现在，我们能否让他们投票反对自己的政党是非常值得怀疑的。

transcript.en_text: - But they might abstain. - - You'd need ten.
transcript.zh_text: - 但他们可能会弃权。- - 你需要十个。

transcript.en_text: Entitlement is the Republicans' white whale. I can get at least two to flip.
transcript.zh_text: 权利是共和党的白鲸。我至少可以找到两个来翻转。

transcript.en_text: Then you'd only need six abstaining.
transcript.zh_text: 那么你只需要六票弃权即可。

transcript.en_text: Erikson's already making calls.
transcript.zh_text: 埃里克森已经打电话了。

transcript.en_text: - Donner. - And Pulaski.
transcript.zh_text: - 唐纳。- 还有普拉斯基。

transcript.en_text: Get me a call list so I can tag-team with him.
transcript.zh_text: 给我一份通话清单，这样我就可以和他组队。

transcript.en_text: Got it right here.
transcript.zh_text: 就在这里。

transcript.en_text: We have to get medieval.
transcript.zh_text: 我们必须进入中世纪。

transcript.en_text: When it comes to parliamentary procedure, there's not a rule I don't know.
transcript.zh_text: 说到议会程序，没有我不知道的规则。

transcript.en_text: Find me the ones we can bend.
transcript.zh_text: 给我找一些我们可以弯曲的。

transcript.en_text: Mark, you're a sensible man.
transcript.zh_text: 马克，你是一个明智的人。

transcript.en_text: Yes, I... I know. I understand.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，我……我知道。我明白。

transcript.en_text: What if...
transcript.zh_text: 如果什么...

transcript.en_text: Tell you what, what if both VA hospitals in your district...
transcript.zh_text: 告诉你，如果你所在地区的两家 VA 医院......

transcript.en_text: Yes, both of them. Hold on.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，他们两个。坚持，稍等。

transcript.en_text: - Who? - Moriarty. I promised him an amendment for his bovine research center.
transcript.zh_text: - WHO？- 莫里亚蒂。我答应他对他的牛研究中心进行修改。

transcript.en_text: - That makes six. - Mark, if I can get you funding for both, are you with us? Excellent.
transcript.zh_text: - 一共六个。- 马克，如果我能为你提供这两项资金，你会和我们一起吗？出色的。

transcript.en_text: Well, you come by the White House and have lunch with me sometime soon.
transcript.zh_text: 好吧，你很快就会来白宫并与我共进午餐。

transcript.en_text: Bye-bye. We have the numbers.
transcript.zh_text: 再见。我们有数字。

transcript.en_text: Once you break the quorum call, it's gonna be a little tricky.
transcript.zh_text: 一旦你打破了法定人数调用，事情就会变得有点棘手。

transcript.en_text: Tell me on the way.
transcript.zh_text: 路上告诉我。

transcript.en_text: Sir.
transcript.zh_text: 先生。

transcript.en_text: - Sir, we might not have a majority. - What?
transcript.zh_text: - 先生，我们可能没有占多数。- 什么？

transcript.en_text: The Dems are poaching people. Donner, Pulaski. Maybe more.
transcript.zh_text: 民主党正在偷猎人民。唐纳、普拉斯基。也许更多。

transcript.en_text: - Voting for the amendment? - Some. Others abstaining.
transcript.zh_text: - 投票赞成修正案？- 一些。其他人弃权。

transcript.en_text: - I'm still trying to figure out who. - We need to delay - and figure out what is going on. - Quorum call.
transcript.zh_text: - 我还在想到底是谁。- 我们需要推迟 - 并弄清楚发生了什么。- 法定人数电话会议。

transcript.en_text: There's 49 hours until the recess. We call a name an hour.
transcript.zh_text: 距离放假还有 49 个小时。我们每小时叫一个名字。

transcript.en_text: - Mr. Avendale? - Here.
transcript.zh_text: - 阿文代尔先生？- 这里。

transcript.en_text: Excuse me, I do believe you're sitting in my chair.
transcript.zh_text: 对不起，我相信你坐在我的椅子上。

transcript.en_text: Mr. Drewery, what is the order of business?
transcript.zh_text: 德鲁里先生，请问工作顺序是怎样的？

transcript.en_text: - We are in a quorum call, sir. - Then why aren't you calling the roll?
transcript.zh_text: - 我们正在进行法定人数通话，先生。- 那你为什么不点名呢？

transcript.en_text: - We are, sir, in a deliberate manner. - Let's speed it up.
transcript.zh_text: - 先生，我们是经过深思熟虑的。- 让我们加快速度吧。

transcript.en_text: - Mr. Brown. - Here.
transcript.zh_text: - 布朗先生。- 这里。

transcript.en_text: - More expeditious than that. - Mr. Burr.
transcript.zh_text: - 比这更迅速。- 伯尔先生。

transcript.en_text: - Here. - Ms. Cantwell.
transcript.zh_text: - 这里。- 坎特韦尔女士。

transcript.en_text: - Here. - Mr. Cerini.
transcript.zh_text: - 这里。- 切里尼先生。

transcript.en_text: - Thank you. - Cornwall.

transcript.en_text: And when the House passes that bill in a few weeks, as I fully expect them to do, we will put the government freeze to rest.
transcript.zh_text: 当众议院在几周内通过该法案时，正如我完全期望的那样，我们将结束政府的冻结。

transcript.en_text: We will continue the business of serving our country rather than paralyzing it.
transcript.zh_text: 我们将继续为我们的国家服务，而不是让它瘫痪。

transcript.en_text: The American people deserve no less.
transcript.zh_text: 美国人民应得的同样如此。

transcript.zh_text: 我们站在民主的祭坛上。
